ValidationRule.description: Onoarding Method is required for Engagement opportunity
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Onboarding_Method__c)), CONTAINS(Pricebook2.Name, 'Engagement'), OR( NOT( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Qualification") || ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Need Analysis") ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Qualification") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Need Analysis"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Proposal") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Onboarding Method is required when the opportunity is for Engagement. Please select a value before proceeding.
